bio.text: Kevin Hensley was first elected in 2014 to represent the 9th District, which includes Odessa, Townsend and Port Penn, in the Delaware House of Representatives.
Hensley is an associate broker with RE/MAX Premier Properties and holds a bachelor's degree in political science from the University of Delaware.
Hensley is a founding member of the MOT Charter School, a past member of the Appoquinimink School Board, and previously worked as a legislative assistant to U.S. Senator William V. Roth.
